Item
1.01. Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.

On
November 24, 2026, Applied Digital Corporation, a Nevada corporation (“Applied Digital” or the “Company”)
entered into a letter agreement (the “Letter Agreement”) with the investors under that certain Preferred Equity Purchase
Agreement, dated April 30, 2025, by and among the Company and the investors signatory thereto (as amended from time to time, the “PEPA”),
in order to increase the aggregate commitment amount available thereunder from $2,000,000,000 to $2,500,000,000. The PEPA covers the
Company’s existing Series G Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “Series G Preferred Stock”).
After giving effect to this increase, there is $1,035,000,000 of remaining availability to be drawn under the PEPA.

The
foregoing description of the Letter Agreement is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Letter Agreement, a form
of which is attached hereto as Exhibit 10.1 and is incorporated in its entirety by reference herein.

Item
3.02. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities.

The
offer and sale of the Series G Preferred Stock pursuant to the PEPA, and the shares of Common Stock issuable upon the conversion of the
Series G Preferred Stock, is and will be made in reliance upon the exemption from registration provided by Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities
Act of 1933, as amended.

This
Current Report on Form 8-K shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of any offer to buy the Series G Preferred Stock
or the shares of Common Stock issuable upon the conversion of the Series G Preferred Stock, nor shall there be an offer, solicitation
or sale of the Series G Preferred Stock or the shares of Common Stock issuable upon the conversion of the Series G Preferred Stock in
any state in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws
of such state.

Item
7.01. Regulation FD Disclosure

On
November 23, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing entry into a new 18-year lease agreement with a tier-one investment-grade
hyperscaler for 150 MW of critical IT capacity at one of its data center campuses.

Also
on November 23, 2026, the Company issued a second press release announcing an indirect subsidiary of the Company has closed on
a bridge loan facility with the lenders party from time to time thereto.

Copies
of the press releases are attached hereto as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, respectively, and are incorporated by reference herein.

The information contained
in this Item 7.01, including the related information set forth in Exhibit 99.1 and Exhibit 99.2, is being “furnished” and
shall not be deemed “filed” for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (“Exchange
Act”), or otherwise. The information in this Item 7.01 shall not be incorporated by reference into any registration statement or
other document pursuant to the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or into any filing or other document pursuant to the Exchange Act,
except as otherwise expressly stated in any such filing.

Applied
Digital Secures New 150 MW, 18-Year Lease with

Tier-One Investment-Grade Hyperscaler, Bringing Contracted Base-Term Revenue Above $41 Billion

Total
potential lease revenue nears $100 billion, with all renewal options

DALLAS,

November 23, 
2026 (GLOBE
NEWSWIRE)

-- Applied Digital (NASDAQ: APLD), a
 U.S. based AI data center infrastructure company specializing in the design, development,
ownership and operation of large-scale, purpose-built campuses serving hyperscale off-takers under long-term contracts, today announced
that it has entered into a new 18-year lease agreement with a tier-one investment-grade hyperscaler for 150 MW of critical IT capacity.

The
lease provides for approximately $5.4 billion in base-term contracted revenue, or approximately $12.7 billion if all renewal options
are exercised over a 33-year total term. With this addition, the Company’s total contracted base-term lease revenue exceeds $41
billion, or approximately $100 billion if all renewal options are exercised.

The
lease contains improved commercial terms over our prior leases, including higher pricing, as Applied Digital continues to scale its AI
infrastructure platform. The 18-year duration gives the Company greater long-term revenue visibility.

With
this latest lease, Applied Digital’s portfolio is over 1.6 GW of total contracted critical IT load and 2.2 GW of grid-connected
peak load. Approximately 75% of the Company’s total contracted base-term lease revenue is now attributable to investment-grade,
which we believe underscores the credit quality of its customer base and the strength of its long-term leasing model.

“Securing
another large-scale, long-term lease with a tier-one investment-grade hyperscaler reinforces to us the strength of our customer relationships
and the quality of our contracted revenue,” said Wes Cummins, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Applied Digital. “We
believe our portfolio reflects the scale and sophistication of the infrastructure we’ve developed, and our focus remains on executing
with the speed, discipline and consistency required for our customers.”

“We
plan to finance this build through our established structure, including first-in equity already funded from our balance sheet and through
our $5 billion programmatic equity partnership with Macquarie Asset Management, followed by project financing supported by the long-term
lease with a tier-one investment-grade tenant,” said Saidal Mohmand, Applied Digital’s Chief Financial Officer. “We
expect to complete the remaining project finance for Delta Forge 1 and Polaris Forge 3 in the first calendar quarter of 2027, followed
by Delta Forge 2 in the second calendar quarter of 2027. This approach is designed to optimize our cost of capital while aligning capital
deployment with construction timelines,” Mr. Mohmand continued.

Delivery
of the capacity is currently anticipated to begin in the first half of calendar 2028, subject to applicable development milestones, utility
arrangements and regulatory approvals.

###

About
Applied Digital

Applied
Digital (Nasdaq: APLD) is a U.S. based AI infrastructure company specializing in the design, development, ownership and operation of
large-scale, purpose-built AI data center campuses.

Combining
the fundamentals of technical real estate with the specialized requirements of digital infrastructure, the Company provides the mission-critical
power, advanced liquid cooling and connectivity required to support artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads.
Applied Digital’s AI Factory campuses are leased to hyperscale customers under long-term contracts, combining specialized infrastructure
assets with predictable, long-term revenue streams.

Through
its repeatable approach to design, development and operations, Applied Digital delivers highly engineered infrastructure designed to
support the demanding requirements of AI computing at scale.

Applied
Digital Announces $300 Million Senior Secured Bridge Facility Led by a Leading Global Financial Institution

DALLAS,
November 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE)
 — Applied Digital (NASDAQ: APLD), a U.S. based AI data center infrastructure company specializing
in the design, development, ownership and operations of large-scale, purpose-built campuses leased to hyperscale customers under long-term
contracts, today announced the closing of a $300 million senior secured bridge facility led by a leading global financial institution.

The
facility is intended to fund the continued development and construction of Delta Forge 1, the Company’s AI Factory campus in Louisiana,
which is backed by a long-term lease with a U.S. based, tier-one investment grade hyperscaler. Applied Digital expects to seek additional
financing to fund the completion of construction at that campus.

The
bridge facility consists of a $300 million delayed draw term loan with a 364-day maturity, bearing interest at the Secured Overnight
Financing Rate (“SOFR”) plus 300 basis points. Draws are subject to meeting certain conditions, including but not limited
to construction milestones, regulatory approvals, including state commission approval of electrical rates, lender consents and certain
financial covenants. The loan is prepayable at any time without premium and is secured by the assets of the project.
